# Bundled Tesseract runtime

- Runtime: Tesseract 5.4.0.20240606, 64-bit Windows build
- Runtime source: https://digi.bib.uni-mannheim.de/tesseract/tesseract-ocr-w64-setup-5.4.0.20240606.exe
- Runtime installer SHA-256: `C885FFF6998E0608BA4BB8AB51436E1C6775C2BAFC2559A19B423E18678B60C9`
- Bundled `tesseract.exe` SHA-256: `BABB405F4366B480D02CD8FF2BAC8D497170F6C1711CE6F3D5D8BF0FB7FA6ED9`
- Simplified Chinese model: `tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast` `chi_sim.traineddata`
- Chinese model source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
- Chinese model SHA-256: `A5FCB6F0DB1E1D6D8522F39DB4E848F05984669172E584E8D76B6B3141E1F730`

The runtime and trained data are distributed under Apache-2.0. Their license
notices are retained as `LICENSE-TESSERACT.txt` and `LICENSE-TESSDATA.txt`.
`README-UPSTREAM.md` is retained from the Windows distribution and documents
its build and dependency sources.
